key_impacts: More than one million persons displaced
Many hospitals and health centres destroyed or damaged
Sanitation facilities and sewage treatment works damaged
evidence_snippets: On 26 December 2004 a 9.0 earthquake west of northern Sumatra triggered a powerful tsunami.
The death toll exceeded 280,000; more than one million persons were displaced.
Rapid health assessments were conducted along the west coast of Aceh; Banda Aceh cited among affected areas.
missing_information: Sub-national locations for other affected countries not specified in the text

evidence_snippets: The 28 March quake affected Nias and neighbouring islands off Sumatra.
Continuing seismic activity in Indonesia with daily aftershocks mentioned.
